title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Rolling Stone | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to Jann Wenner of Rolling Stone magazine on 8 December 1970.

The interview took place in the conference room at ABKCO’s New York offices at 1700 Broadway, New York City.

The vituperative, impassioned interview was published in two parts in Rolling Stone, on 21 January and 4 February 1971, and in book form as Lennon Remembers. It found Lennon in particularly combative form, discussing subjects including The Beatles, drugs, primal therapy, Apple, Allen Klein, and former friends and associates.

A follow-up telephone call by Wenner to Lennon took place before the end of December. A scheduled interview with Ono by Rolling Stone journalist Jonathan Cott was postponed to 13 and 14 December.
